participant_roles: Context: LogManager; Strategy: LogBackend; Concrete Strategies: BootstrapConsoleBackend, JsonConsoleBackend, PrettyConsoleBackend
intent_and_evidence: LogManager depends on the LogBackend abstraction and delegates write operations to the selected backend. createLoggingBackend selects a concrete backend and setBackend permits runtime replacement. Multiple application-owned implementations provide interchangeable logging behavior.

participant_roles: Target: telemetry registry/application; Adapter: TelemetryAdapter; Concrete Adapter: SentryTelemetryAdapter; External adaptee: Sentry APIs
intent_and_evidence: TelemetryAdapter hides implementation differences between telemetry providers. SentryTelemetryAdapter translates Misskey telemetry operations to Sentry APIs, while the registry consumes only the adapter interface.

participant_roles: Repository abstraction: MiRepository; Concrete injected repositories: UsersRepository, FollowingsRepository and other TypeORM repositories; Clients: application services such as UserService
intent_and_evidence: Application services obtain persistence operations through repository abstractions injected by the application module. RepositoryModule creates/extends the repository implementation and domain services use repository methods rather than owning persistence infrastructure.

instance_name: Global Redis Event Publication and Streaming Subscription
participant_roles: Publisher: GlobalEventService; broker: Redis; Subscriber/consumer: StreamingApiServerService; consumers: streaming connections/global event emitter
intent_and_evidence: GlobalEventService publishes typed events through Redis, while StreamingApiServerService subscribes to Redis messages and forwards them to interested streaming consumers. Redis provides decoupling between publisher and subscribers.

participant_roles: Producer: QueueService.deliver/deliverMany; Queue: deliverQueue; Job payload: DeliverJobData; Consumer: DeliverProcessorService
intent_and_evidence: Federation delivery is represented as queued job data and processed asynchronously by a dedicated processor. The queue provides decoupling, retries/backoff, and delayed execution.

participant_roles: Cache: FederatedInstanceService cache; primary store: FederatedInstanceRepository; client/service: FederatedInstanceService
intent_and_evidence: fetchOrRegister and fetch check cache first, fall back to the repository on a miss, then populate the cache. Updates write the database and refresh the cache.

participant_roles: L1: MemorySingleCache; L2: Redis; facade: RedisSingleCache
intent_and_evidence: RedisSingleCache maintains a memory cache in front of Redis. get checks memory first, then Redis and repopulates memory; set/delete update both layers.

participant_roles: Front Controller: ApiCallService; route/server registration: ApiServerService; endpoint providers: EndpointsModule/endpoint providers
intent_and_evidence: API requests are routed through ApiCallService.handleRequest/call, which centralizes authentication, authorization, rate limits, role checks and endpoint invocation instead of duplicating these concerns in every endpoint.

participant_roles: Factory: createLoggingBackend; Product: LogBackend; Concrete Products: PrettyConsoleBackend, JsonConsoleBackend; caller: configureLogging
intent_and_evidence: createLoggingBackend selects and constructs the concrete LogBackend from configuration. The factory separates product creation from the runtime logging context.

participant_roles: Pool: Pool; pooled resource: SharedConnection; clients: useSharedConnection/Stream; lifecycle: inc/dec/disconnect
intent_and_evidence: Shared streaming connections are reused among multiple users of the same channel. Pool tracks users, connects on first use, decrements references and disconnects after the pool becomes unused.

participant_roles: Subject/event source: globalEvents EventEmitter; observers: MkDrive, MkNotesTimeline, MkStreamingNotesTimeline, use-note, settings/drive-cleaner
intent_and_evidence: Global frontend events are emitted independently of subscribers. Components/composables subscribe and react to events, with lifecycle cleanup on unmount.

participant_roles: Subject: noteEvents EventEmitter; publisher/filter: use-note-capture realtimeSubscribe; observers: note-specific subscriptions
intent_and_evidence: The event source is scoped by note ID and emits reacted/unreacted/pollVoted events. Independent note observers react to those events and clean up with component lifecycle.

participant_roles: Subject: ThemeManager; observers/listeners: MkAnalogClock, MkFoldableSection, adaptive-border directive and internal listeners
source_locations: packages/frontend/src/theme.ts: ThemeManager and ThemeManagerEvents; listener call sites in frontend components/directives
intent_and_evidence: ThemeManager emits theme lifecycle events such as previewStateChanged, themeChanged, requestUpdateThemeCache and themeChanging. Multiple application consumers subscribe and update independently.

participant_roles: Subject: deckGlobalEvents; publisher: column.vue; observers: deck/column consumers
intent_and_evidence: Drag lifecycle events are published through a shared event emitter and observers subscribe/unsubscribe to react to column drag state.

participant_roles: Mediator: Stream; colleagues: Connection, SharedConnection, NonSharedConnection, Pool
intent_and_evidence: Stream centrally coordinates connection creation, pooling, message dispatch, reconnection and cleanup. Individual Connection objects delegate sending and lifecycle coordination through Stream instead of directly coordinating with every other connection.

participant_roles: Router: Nirax; route definitions/current route state; navigation clients/listeners
source_locations: packages/frontend/src/lib/nirax.ts: Nirax class, resolve, resolveForNavigation, navigate and change event handling
intent_and_evidence: Nirax owns route definitions and navigation state, resolves URLs to routes/parameters, performs navigation redirects/loop checks and emits route changes to consumers.

participant_roles: Subject: PreferencesManager; event: committed; observer: preferences.ts listener; cross-tab transport: preferencesChannel
intent_and_evidence: PreferencesManager emits a committed event after a preference is saved. The preferences module observes it and propagates the update through the cross-context channel.

participant_roles: Factory/context: Stream.useChannel; products: SharedConnection and NonSharedConnection; product abstraction: Connection
source_locations: packages/misskey-js/src/streaming.ts: Connection; useChannel; useSharedConnection; connectToChannel; SharedConnection; NonSharedConnection
intent_and_evidence: Stream.useChannel selects and constructs either a shared or non-shared Connection according to the request. Both concrete products share the Connection abstraction.

participant_roles: Application services: AnnouncementService, RoleService, SignupService and other domain/application services; clients: API endpoints/modules
intent_and_evidence: Core application services expose cohesive use-case/domain operations to API and other application clients while coordinating repositories, entity services, IDs, events and other infrastructure.

participant_roles: Plugin host/core: plugin.ts; plugin context: Interpreter; extension points: pluginHandlers/addPluginHandler; plugins: installed plugin definitions
source_locations: packages/frontend/src/plugin.ts: installPlugin, addPluginHandler, launchPlugin, abortPlugin, reloadPlugin, createPluginEnv
intent_and_evidence: The frontend core hosts dynamically installed plugins, maintains plugin contexts, exposes controlled extension handlers/environment and controls plugin lifecycle. This is an application-owned plugin/microkernel-style extension architecture.

participant_roles: Template: abstract Chart.tick; primitive operations: tickMajor/tickMinor; concrete subclasses: ActiveUsersChart, ApRequestChart, DriveChart, FederationChart, InstanceChart, NotesChart and others
source_locations: packages/backend/src/core/chart/core.ts: abstract Chart, tick, tickMajor, tickMinor; concrete Chart subclasses under packages/backend/src/core/chart/
intent_and_evidence: Chart.tick defines the invariant processing algorithm while delegating major/minor calculation to subclass hooks. Common range/column/persistence behavior remains in the base template.

participant_roles: Proxy: AnalyticsProxy; Subject/interface: AnalyticsInstance; real subject: dynamically initialized analytics AnalyticsInstance
source_locations: packages/frontend/src/analytics.ts:12-78, exported analytics instance and initAnalytics
intent_and_evidence: AnalyticsProxy implements the same AnalyticsInstance interface and forwards identify/track/page/user/reset/ready/on/once/getState/storage/plugins to the wrapped analytics object. It additionally supplies safe fallback behavior before initialization and injects the real analytics instance through setAnalytics.
